reviewMethod: Real-use integer rectangles entered after visual inspection of the originals and checked at border scanlines. Automated references are rounded DOM bounds, visually checked. No detector output supplies expected bounds; not an independent human annotation study.
partitionPolicy: Real games 001-003 per platform: development; games 004-005: evaluation. Every variant stays with its game. All automated pilot variants belong to their pre-existing training source group and remain development. Split fixed before running the detector on held-out cases.
